title: NetworkConsentCheckRequest
description: network.consent-check-request@1 (L24): may this purpose be used for these people? POST /internal/consent/check on OpenVibe.Network with a service token holding network.consent.read. One purpose per call, up to 500 subjects (a dataset build or a chat log checks its authors in batches).

kind.description: The kind of content the use is about. A choice limited to other kinds answers false.

client.description: app.data only: the app asking. Required for app.data.

feature.description: face.recognize only: the recognition about to run.

subjects.description: The people the use would be about.
